en: Yesterday: when Person one was six, Person two was half as old. Now Person one is seventy.
Half of six is three. So back then, Person two was three years old.
That means Person two is always three years younger. The gap never changes!
Seventy minus three, is sixty seven. Not thirty five!
Person one buys a pen and a notebook. Together, they cost one pound ten.
The notebook costs exactly one pound more than the pen.
So, how much does the pen cost?
Comment your answer. The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise.
